items.verbatim_snippet: After more than 14 years of visionary leadership as President and CEO, Altaf Stationwala announced in late March 2025 that he would be moving to Unity Health Toronto as their President and CEO, effective July 1, 2025. His last day at Mackenzie Health was June 27, 2025.

The Board of Directors announced that Mary-Agnes Wilson, who had served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Nursing Executive for seven years, would step into the role of Interim President and CEO.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health / Orillia Soldiers' Memorial Hospital
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health announced the appointment of Carmine Stumpo as its new President and Chief Executive Officer, effective April 13, 2026. Stumpo joined from Orillia Soldiers' Memorial Hospital (OSMH), where he had served as President and CEO since 2018.

items.role: Chair of the Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: At Mackenzie Health's Annual General Meeting on July 14, 2021, Fay Lim-Lambie was appointed as the new Chair of the Board of Directors. She succeeded outgoing Chair Mark Falbo, President of Mircom Group of Companies.

items.role: Chair of the Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: At Mackenzie Health's Annual General Meeting on July 14, 2021, Fay Lim-Lambie was appointed as the new Chair of the Board of Directors. Lim-Lambie, who had been a board member since 2016, was Dean of the Centre for Health Sciences and the Centre for Community Services and Early Childhood at George Brown College.
Along with Lim-Lambie's appointment, Stephanie Zee (Managing Director within the Financial Crimes Unit at BMO Financial Group) was named the new Vice-Chair of the board.
Outgoing board members Gary D'Andrea, Anthony Ianni and Len Koroneos, who had recently completed their terms, were thanked for their service.

items.role: Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: Stephanie Zee was appointed Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors at its Annual General Meeting on June 13, 2024. Zee, a Richmond Hill resident and Vice President at a major Canadian financial institution (BMO Financial Group), had been a board member since 2016 and was elected Vice-Chair in 2021.

Along with the appointment of Stephanie Zee as Board Chair in June 2024, Mackenzie Health announced that Ruby Philip-Katyal and Joby McKenzie had been appointed Vice-Chairs to the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors.

items.role: Interim President and CEO of Mackenzie Health Foundation
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health and Mackenzie Health Foundation announced the appointment of Nicole McCahon as the new President and CEO of Mackenzie Health Foundation, effective June 19, 2023. McCahon joined from William Osler Health System Foundation, where she had spent five years. Luci Anderson had served as Interim President and CEO during the transitional period.
